facts.fact: Liberia, Ghana and Sierra Leone entered the ECOWAS Free Roaming Agreement at a signing ceremony, to remove roaming charges among the three; the page carries no date, so the published date 2026-02-20 is used.

systems.owner: ECOWAS; signed by Liberia, Ghana, Sierra Leone
systems.tiers: mobile users in the three countries

note: The parties only reaffirmed intent to implement it, so no effect fact.
